worker-entries.reason: The Workers runtime reads the default export and each Durable Object or Container class of a Worker `main` file by name.

tool-entries.reason: Vitest, VitePress and the aliases of the Vitest configs load the default export or the classes of these files by name.

type-checks.reason: A fixture or a type check is a compile-time test that no file imports. Its exports keep each check from noUnusedLocals (the ignoreIssues of knip.json).

tests.reason: A test file. The Refactor 17 rules allow no change to a test but its imports.

execution-bundle.reason: The `export *` of the execution worker is the interface of the retained engine bundle for a host that is not a worker. A change of the line changes the bytes and the identity of each new bundle.

commerce-spec.reason: services/commerce/docs/spec.md names these record and lifecycle types. They are public shapes of the commerce engine for an outside client.

commerce-engine-reexports.reason: services/commerce/scripts/configure-patisserie-menu.ts imports these names to re-export them. The Refactor 17 rules allow no change in services/commerce but the loss of an import.

brand-mark.reason: PurinMark and PurinIcon are the Purin brand mark of the component kit (foundation/ui/README.md, docs/brand/purin-logo). No page draws it yet; the owner decides where it goes.

port-interfaces.reason: The interface type of a port is the typed shape that its owner implements (definePort<T>, Refactor 17 rule 4). The port value is the import; the type stays public so that an implementation or a test harness can name it.
